symbols.read: AAOI carries a bullish bias with price at 130.26 pressing directly into the 131.15 upper pivot, which doubles as the stated entry trigger. The 1H trend is up, but the last hourly candle is flat-to-slightly-negative at -0.11%, and an open bearish FVG sits just below at 127.89–129.62, making that zone the immediate friction point on any pullback. A break and hold above 131.15 opens the path toward the 168.68 target, while failure below the 128.85 stop invalidates the setup and shifts focus back toward the 93.62 lower pivot.

AMD carries a bullish bias, with price at 679.25 holding above the upper pivot of 658.52 and the regime flagged BULLISH. The 1H trend remains up, though the last hourly bar slipped 646.15→643.12 (-0.47%), a minor pullback rather than a reversal. The long setup triggers at the 658.52 entry with a stop at 650.94 and target at 836.71, while the lower pivot at 480.33 marks the deeper structural floor. Invalidation is a break below 650.94, which would kill the entry and shift the read to neutral.

DRAM carries a bullish 1D bias with a HOLD on the combined timeframe, but the 1H trend is down and price at 59.88 sits below two open bearish FVGs (60.78–61.49 and 61.29–61.71) that cap near-term upside. The setup is a breakout watch: entry triggers on a push through the 63.82 upper pivot, with stop 63.19 and target 73.36, while the 59.50–59.79 bull FVG is the immediate support shelf to hold. Bias stays bullish while price holds above the 54.28 lower pivot; a 1H close back under the bull FVG would signal the pullback is deepening and put the breakout on hold.

ORCL bias is bearish on the 1D, but the combined 1D+1H signal sits at HOLD with a bullish regime and a rising 1H trend, so this is a setup on watch rather than an active short. Price at 149.82 is mid-range between the 166.00 upper pivot and 131.58 lower pivot, with no open fair value gaps to pull toward. The trade triggers only on a break of 131.58, targeting 97.16 with a stop at 133.40. Invalidation is a stop-out above 133.40, and the bullish regime plus 1H uptrend means the short stays unconfirmed until that lower pivot gives way.

VOO is bullish on the daily with the 1H trend up, but price at 714.47 sits below the 718.47 upper pivot and the combined signal is only HOLD, so this is a watching setup rather than an active long. A stack of unfilled bull fair value gaps from 700.16 up to 714.14 marks the demand shelf beneath price, with the 689.04 lower pivot as the deeper structural floor. The trigger is a break and hold above 718.47, which opens the run to 747.90 with invalidation at 716.53; failure to reclaim the pivot keeps price pinned in the 714–718 range and leaves the bias neutral.
